notes.title: So excited to announce Dead Exhale
notes.content:
[b]Features of this game include:[/b]
Voice detection from monster
Voice activated ability
Super Advanced AI
Upgrade system for character
Puzzles
Early testing happening here: https://www.patreon.com/c/hewhoisseth

I haven't had any testing yet so it's super rough around the edges but we'll get there.

-Seth
